question: There were two Annual Programs implemented in India in 1990-91 and 1991-92 (between _______ five year plans).
solution:
The correct answer is __**seventh and eighth.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Two Annual Programs** were implemented in India in **1990-91 and 1991-92.**
 
• These programs were implemented between the** seventh and eighth** five year plans.
 
• The main objective of these programs was to increase **agricultural productivity** and** rural development.**
 
• The programs aimed to provide support to farmers and improve **infrastructure** in rural areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Indian economy** was built on the idea of planning from **1947 until 2017.**
 
• This was implemented through the Five-Year Plans, which were created, carried out, and overseen by the **NITI Aayog **and the** Planning Commission. **
 
• **First and second five year plans** were implemented much earlier, between **1951-1956** and **1956-1961 **respectively.
 
• **Third and fourth** five year plans were implemented between** 1961-1966 **and **1969-1974** respectively.
 
• **Fifth and sixth **five year plans were implemented between **1974-1979** and **1980-1985** respectively.
